entities.summary: Kuninkaanhauta is a Bronze Age tumulus in the village of Panelia in Eura, Finland, dating back to c. 1500–1300 BC. It is the largest burial cairn in Finland, Kuninkaanhauta is 36×30 meters wide and about four meters high.
